CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce((auth.jwt() -> 'app_metadata' ->> 'role') = 'admin', false)
     and coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'aal', '') = 'aal2';
$function$

arguments=p_d text; security_definer=f; ACL={postgres=X/postgres}
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.valid_domain(p_d text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select p_d ~ '^([a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?\.)+([a-z]{2,24}|xn--[a-z0-9-]{1,59})$'
     and char_length(p_d) <= 253
     and p_d !~ '\.(local|localhost|internal|lan|home|corp|intranet|invalid|test|arpa|onion)$';
$function$

arguments=p_limit integer; security_definer=t; ACL={postgres=X/postgres,authenticated=X/postgres,service_role=X/postgres}
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.review_queue(p_limit integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, indicator_type text, value_norm text, claimed_verdict text, created_at timestamp with time zone, distinct_contributors bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not private.is_admin() then raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
  return query
    select s.id, s.indicator_type, s.value_norm, s.claimed_verdict, s.created_at,
           (select count(distinct x.contributor_id) from public.indicator_submissions x
              where x.indicator_type = s.indicator_type and x.value_norm = s.value_norm)
      from public.indicator_submissions s
     where s.status = 'pending'
     order by s.created_at
     limit least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 50), 1), 200);              -- contributor identity is never returned
end $function$
